list.name: node_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT node_id FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE metric_name LIKE 'jvm_%' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY node_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 15 SECOND) AS time, substring(node_id, 1, 8) AS node, max(value) AS value FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'process_uptime' AND timestamp BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND ($__conditionalAll(node_id IN ($node_id), $node_id)) GROUP BY time, node ORDER BY time
